name: relaylab
description: RelayLab: receive, inspect, replay, and debug webhooks

scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && pnpm migrate && pnpm -r --parallel run "/^dev(:api|:worker)?$/"
scripts.dev:backend: pnpm db:up && pnpm migrate && pnpm --filter @relaylab/backend --parallel run "/^dev:(api|worker)$/"
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
